Theme

Time, the calendar & feasts

April noun

also in April

classical

Plin. Ep. 1.13.1: tōtō mēnse Aprīlī
Traupman 77

Aprīlis, Aprīle

adjective, with mēnsis; also a masculine noun (sc. mēnsis), declension

of April; April

Kalendae, Nōnae, Īdūs Aprīlēs: the 1st, 5th and 13th. Varro and Ovid derive the name from aperīre, the month that opens the earth (Varro, LL 6.33; Ov. F. 4.87–89); its real origin is uncertain.

Examples

  • Magnum prōventum poētārum annus hic attulit: tōtō mēnse Aprīlī nūllus ferē diēs, quō nōn recitāret aliquis.

    This year has brought a fine crop of poets: in the whole of April there was hardly a day when someone was not giving a reading.Plin. Ep. 1.13.1

  • mēnse Aprīlī

    in AprilTraupman 272

See also month, March, May, the Ides.
